# mergeah_tool_pack (Resource)

Manage a Tool Pack. Manage connector membership separately with mergeah_tool_pack_connectors or individual mergeah_tool_pack_connector resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_tool_pack" "example" {
  name        = "Support agent"
  description = "Tools for the support agent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Merge API field `description`.
- `name` (String) Merge API field `name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_tool_pack.example '134e0111-0f67-44f6-98f0-597000290bb3'
```
